items.t: Western Digital Stock Falls 12% in the Memory Chip Selloff. It Spun Off Its Flash Business Last Year and Now Sits 65% Below Its Record
items.sum: Western Digital (WDC) fell 12% to about $261 on Friday as the AI chip selloff hit memory and storage stocks for a second day. The hard drive maker spun off its flash business in 2025, is 65% below its June record and trades at about 20 times trailing adjusted earnings.

items.t: Western Digital Cratered 40% in The Last 3 Months: This Wall Street Desk Now Predicts 200% Returns After Raising Its Target Price
items.sum: Western Digital keeps posting record results and analysts keep raising estimates, yet the stock keeps sliding. One Wall Street desk sees a rebound far bigger than the rest, and the reason may lie in a corner of the AI buildout most investors ignore.

items.t: Micron Stock Plunges 13% as Barron’s Calls Memory Stocks ‘Agonizingly Cheap’; Western Digital, SanDisk and Seagate Sink in AI Chip Selloff
items.sum: Micron fell 13% on Friday and sits 50% below its June record as Barron's calls memory stocks "agonizingly cheap." The stock's last two busts ended after drops of 50% and 54%. Here is the case for and against.
